questions.text: Does a hybrid navigation architecture that combines global path planning with reactive local avoidance outperform any single-strategy approach across path efficiency, obstacle avoidance rate, and mission success in cluttered urban environments?
Which global planning algorithm (A*, Dijkstra, RRT, Potential Field) produces the best path quality metrics when used as the global component of a hybrid navigation system?
Which hybrid fusion strategy (weighted blend, distance-gated, confidence-weighted) produces the optimal trade-off between path efficiency and collision avoidance in urban environments?

hypotheses.text: A hybrid navigation architecture will produce path efficiency scores ≥10% higher than any single-strategy baseline, with p < 0.05, across n=10 trials in the downtown scenario.
A* will produce shorter paths than RRT but longer computation time; Dijkstra will behave comparably to A* with higher node exploration counts.
hypotheses.prediction: path_length: PF < A* < Dijkstra < RRT; compute_time: PF < A* < Dijkstra < RRT

modules.name: Webots Simulation
modules.description: Webots R2025a simulation environment with 6 urban worlds, DJI Mavic 2 Pro model, crowd and bird agents.
modules.notes: 6 worlds available. resetPhysics() workaround in place.

modules.name: Planner Factory
modules.description: Runtime registry for all path planning algorithms. Instantiates planners by name from YAML config.
modules.notes: A*, Dijkstra, RRT exist but not yet in factory pattern. Potential Field missing.

modules.name: Avoidance Factory
modules.description: Runtime registry for collision avoidance modules. Two-tier architecture: primary (8-ray) + emergency safety layer.
modules.notes: Both avoidance modules exist but embedded in monolith. Factory not yet created.

modules.name: Hybrid Coordinator
modules.description: Fuses global planning direction with reactive avoidance vectors. Core research contribution module.
modules.notes: Weighted blend fusion exists inline. Not yet isolated as a pluggable module.

modules.name: Navigation Engine
modules.description: Mission state machine (GROUND_IDLE→ASCEND→NAVIGATE→ARRIVED). Kinematic flight model.
modules.notes: Functional but embedded in 3157-line monolith. Needs extraction in Phase 2.

modules.name: Safety Manager
modules.description: Hard constraint enforcement: geofence, altitude bounds, emergency stops. Independent of algorithm stack.
modules.notes: CollisionSafetyLayer exists inline. Not yet a standalone module with hard override authority.

modules.name: Metrics Engine
modules.description: Ground-truth metric collection (M01–M16) with quality designations. Validates measurement anomalies.
modules.notes: Metrics collected per-run. physics_contacts always 0 (known issue). nodes_explored cumulative (bug). TRR is proxy.

modules.name: Experiment Manager
modules.description: Orchestrates all experiments. Assigns IDs, locks configs, monitors runs, triggers benchmark engine.

modules.name: Benchmark Engine
modules.description: Statistical analysis pipeline: computes CI, p-values, effect sizes, Pareto ranking, and publication figures.
modules.notes: BenchmarkLogger exists for RL. Full benchmark engine not yet built.

modules.name: Research Dashboard
modules.description: Entry point for all project participants. Reads dashboard_state.json and renders a self-contained HTML report.
modules.notes: Phase 1 primary deliverable. Currently being implemented.

modules.name: Report Generator
modules.description: Converts benchmark outputs to HTML, PDF, and LaTeX for internal review and paper submission.

modules.name: Swarm Coordinator
modules.description: Multi-agent mission orchestrator: sector assignment, inter-UAV coordination, leader election.
modules.notes: Phase 8 deliverable. Extension slot exists in architecture.

modules.name: RL Optimization Engine
modules.description: Replaces hand-coded HybridCoordinator fusion with a learned PPO policy.
modules.notes: Infrastructure exists (gym wrapper, reward functions, SB3 trainer). Frozen until Phase 4 complete.

algorithms.name: A* (Grid 8-connected)
algorithms.notes: Euclidean or Manhattan heuristic. LOS post-smoothing. Grid: 2m/cell.

algorithms.name: Dijkstra (Zero Heuristic)
algorithms.notes: A* variant with h=0. Explores more nodes but guarantees optimal.

algorithms.name: RRT (Bidirectional)
algorithms.notes: Continuous-space sampling. Higher compute, smoother paths.

algorithms.name: Potential Field
algorithms.notes: Config entry exists; implementation missing. Priority: Phase 2.

algorithms.name: 8-Ray Geometric Sensor
algorithms.notes: Geometric ray-casting (not real Webots sensors). 14m range, power-law falloff.

algorithms.name: Safety Layer Repulsion
algorithms.notes: Emergency fail-safe. Fires only in WARNING/EMERGENCY state. Surface-distance based.

algorithms.name: Velocity Obstacle (VO)
algorithms.notes: Phase 7 deliverable. Required for dynamic obstacle and multi-UAV avoidance.

algorithms.name: Weighted Blend Fusion
algorithms.notes: Fixed weights: astar=0.65, avoidance=0.35. Currently inline in controller.

algorithms.name: Distance-Gated Fusion
algorithms.notes: Phase 4 deliverable. Blend weight determined by obstacle proximity.

algorithms.name: Confidence-Weighted Fusion
algorithms.notes: Phase 4 deliverable. Avoidance authority scales with threat level.

algorithms.name: RL Learned Fusion
algorithms.notes: Phase 10 deliverable. PPO policy replaces hand-coded fusion function.
